items.notes: Manual semantic review binds Cook4Me 'Cooking cream, 15% fat' to USDA SR Legacy 'Cream, fluid, half and half' through a retained exact evidence record. The destination explicitly identifies fluid cream at 15% fat, and half-and-half is a much closer cultured-free dairy-cream nutrient profile than sour cream, cream cheese, or heavy cream. Confidence remains medium because commercial European cooking cream can differ in milk-fat percentage, UHT processing, stabilizers, and milk/cream formulation from the USDA half-and-half reference; this decision applies only to labels that explicitly state 15% fat and does not generalize to vague low-fat cream, crème fraîche, sour cream, heavy cream, or plant-based cream.
